body: From the DM-266 review (orchestrator, this run): eight score read tools settle the read run's overdue leases (timing.ts:348 -> expireLeases, like get_run): do NOT pin 'no database row changes' as an unconditional invariant for reader calls; reword src/mcp/tools/metrics.ts:5-6 and :79 ('no tool records feedback, defects or budgets; reads may settle the run's overdue leases like get_run'). Fix description gaps: :98 omits verification basis review_unknown; :105 says only a person or reviewing session records defects (orchestrator also can, metricReports.ts:190); :17-19 says ISO 8601 but offset-less times are refused; :31,:35 hard-code current policy numbers.
